card.name: Words in testing and substandard-quality phrases
card.fires_on: The word "stimulation" in "ACTH stimulation test", and words in phrases about substandard or counterfeit medicines. It also fires on words in diagnostic test instructions and in vaccine response wording.

modes.label: ACTH stimulation test
modes.description: The word "stimulation" right after ACTH when a test of adrenal function is described.
modes.example: Evaluation for HPA axis suppression may be done by using the adrenocorticotropic hormone (ACTH)<< stimulation>> test.

modes.label: Substandard or counterfeit medicines
modes.description: Words in the phrase about sourcing sub-standard, counterfeit or contaminated medicines.
modes.example: It has also helped to eliminate or vastly reduce the risk of sourcing sub<<-standard>>, counterfeit and/or contaminated medicines.

modes.label: Vaccine response or test steps
modes.description: Words in lines about reduced vaccine response or in diagnostic test procedures.
modes.example: Patient’s antibody response to vaccines may be<< decreased>>. Consider consultation with a specialist.
